description:
Import the MySQL database dump file located at '/home/ga/databases/chinook_backup.sql' into the existing database 'acmecorp_chinook' for the virtual server 'acmecorp.test'.

1. Navigate to the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server in Virtualmin.
2. Go to the Database management section (Edit Databases).
3. Select the 'acmecorp_chinook' database (it is currently empty).
4. Use the 'Execute SQL' or 'Import Database' feature to load the content of '/home/ga/databases/chinook_backup.sql'.
5. Verify that the tables (Album, Artist, Track, etc.) have been created and populated.
